boxplot(df_final$Weekly_Sales, main="Outliers en Ventas Semanales")

# Contar outliers usando IQR
Q1 <- quantile(df_final$Weekly_Sales, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
Q3 <- quantile(df_final$Weekly_Sales, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
IQR <- Q3 - Q1
outliers <- sum(df_final$Weekly_Sales < (Q1 - 1.5*IQR) | df_final$Weekly_Sales > (Q3 + 1.5*IQR))
cat("Número de outliers:", outliers)
